name: glacier
description: Amazon Glacier (Glacier) is a storage solution for "cold data." Glacier is an extremely low-cost storage service that provides secure, durable, and easy-to-use storage for data backup and archival.

subcommands.name: abort-multipart-upload
subcommands.description: This operation aborts a multipart upload identified by the upload ID.

subcommands.name: abort-vault-lock
subcommands.description: This operation aborts the vault locking process if the vault lock is not in the Locked state.

subcommands.name: add-tags-to-vault
subcommands.description: This operation adds the specified tags to a vault.

subcommands.name: complete-multipart-upload
subcommands.description: You call this operation to inform Amazon Glacier (Glacier) that all the archive parts have been uploaded and that Glacier can now assemble the archive from the uploaded parts.

subcommands.name: complete-vault-lock
subcommands.description: This operation completes the vault locking process by transitioning the vault lock from the InProgress state to the Locked state, which causes the vault lock policy to become unchangeable.

subcommands.name: create-vault
subcommands.description: This operation creates a new vault with the specified name.

subcommands.name: delete-archive
subcommands.description: This operation deletes an archive from a vault.

subcommands.name: delete-vault
subcommands.description: This operation deletes a vault.

subcommands.name: delete-vault-access-policy
subcommands.description: This operation deletes the access policy associated with the specified vault.

subcommands.name: delete-vault-notifications
subcommands.description: This operation deletes the notification configuration set for a vault.

subcommands.name: describe-job
subcommands.description: This operation returns information about a job you previously initiated, including the job initiation date, the user who initiated the job, the job status code/message and the Amazon SNS topic to notify after Amazon Glacier (Glacier) completes the job.

subcommands.name: describe-vault
subcommands.description: This operation returns information about a vault, including the vault's Amazon Resource Name (ARN), the date the vault was created, the number of archives it contains, and the total size of all the archives in the vault.

subcommands.name: get-data-retrieval-policy
subcommands.description: This operation returns the current data retrieval policy for the account and region specified in the GET request.

subcommands.name: get-job-output
subcommands.description: This operation downloads the output of the job you initiated using InitiateJob.

subcommands.name: get-vault-access-policy
subcommands.description: This operation retrieves the access-policy subresource set on the vault; for more information on setting this subresource, see Set Vault Access Policy (PUT access-policy).

subcommands.name: get-vault-lock
subcommands.description: This operation retrieves the following attributes from the lock-policy subresource set on the specified vault: The vault lock policy set on the vault.

subcommands.name: get-vault-notifications
subcommands.description: This operation retrieves the notification-configuration subresource of the specified vault.

subcommands.name: initiate-job
subcommands.description: This operation initiates a job of the specified type, which can be a select, an archival retrieval, or a vault retrieval.

subcommands.name: initiate-multipart-upload
subcommands.description: This operation initiates a multipart upload.

subcommands.name: initiate-vault-lock
subcommands.description: This operation initiates the vault locking process by doing the following: Installing a vault lock policy on the specified vault.

subcommands.name: list-jobs
subcommands.description: This operation lists jobs for a vault, including jobs that are in-progress and jobs that have recently finished.

subcommands.name: list-multipart-uploads
subcommands.description: This operation lists in-progress multipart uploads for the specified vault.

subcommands.name: list-parts
subcommands.description: This operation lists the parts of an archive that have been uploaded in a specific multipart upload.

subcommands.name: list-provisioned-capacity
subcommands.description: This operation lists the provisioned capacity units for the specified AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-vault
subcommands.description: This operation lists all the tags attached to a vault.

subcommands.name: list-vaults
subcommands.description: This operation lists all vaults owned by the calling user's account.

subcommands.name: purchase-provisioned-capacity
subcommands.description: This operation purchases a provisioned capacity unit for an AWS account.

subcommands.name: remove-tags-from-vault
subcommands.description: This operation removes one or more tags from the set of tags attached to a vault.

subcommands.name: set-data-retrieval-policy
subcommands.description: This operation sets and then enacts a data retrieval policy in the region specified in the PUT request.

subcommands.name: set-vault-access-policy
subcommands.description: This operation configures an access policy for a vault and will overwrite an existing policy.

subcommands.name: set-vault-notifications
subcommands.description: This operation configures notifications that will be sent when specific events happen to a vault.

subcommands.name: upload-archive
subcommands.description: This operation adds an archive to a vault.

subcommands.name: upload-multipart-part
subcommands.description: This operation uploads a part of an archive.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: vault-exists
subcommands.description: Wait until 200 response is received when polling with ``describe-vault``.

subcommands.name: vault-not-exists
subcommands.description: Wait until ResourceNotFoundException is thrown when polling with ``describe-vault``.
